name: Shiba Yoshiteru
concept: Yoshiteru's eyes move to track a shugenja the moment one enters a room, and do not move away until they leave it.

answers.giri: Yoshiteru serves Shiba Tamiko, the daimyō's secondmost advisor on Shadowlands doctrine, and must report to her weekly on threats the Phoenix's shugenja do not see coming—which means telling her when her own priests are wrong.
answers.ninjo: Yoshiteru wants Tamiko to name the shugenja he is to die for, so that he stops deciding it himself. She never has. The Moto healer who takes other men's wounds into his own body is the one he cannot decide about.
answers.standout_quality: Yoshiteru practices drawing his blade in the courtyard at dusk when no one watches, counting the heartbeats between deciding and the steel clearing the saya, trying to shave them down to nothing.
answers.accomplishment: He recognized the tremor in a Phoenix shugenja's voice during a briefing at Shiro Kaiu and reported her advancing exhaustion to Tamiko before the woman collapsed into meditation-sickness, but now he listens to her breathing in the ward and knows he was wrong about which ones could be saved.
answers.challenge: He cannot pay court to the shugenja he serves without his sincerity showing through like a crack in lacquer, making them doubt whether his protection comes from duty or from his private arithmetic about their worth.
answers.peace: Yoshiteru feeds the small grey cat that lives in the Phoenix compound's armory, setting down rice and dried fish while it winds between his boots, the only creature in his household that does not require him to know what he thinks of it.
answers.fear: When Yoshiteru reports to Tamiko on a shugenja's fraying concentration, the woman's face goes still, and he is certain he has just condemned someone to die by his own hand instead of saving them.
answers.accoutrement: Saya cord. Retied a fraction tighter.

clan_relationship.text: Yoshiteru's Phoenix brothers assume a Guardian exists to shield their priests from the world's violence, not to measure which ones are worth the cost.

mentor.name: Seppun Yuko
mentor.text: Seppun Yuko taught Yoshiteru to measure the space between intention and action by drilling draws until his hand moved before his mind could argue, but never told him what to do with the clarity once he had it.

answers.first_impression: Yoshiteru's eyes move to track a shugenja the moment one enters a room, and do not move away until they leave it.
answers.stress_reaction: When Yoshiteru is certain he has just ordered someone's death, he leaves the room and stands in the courtyard retying the silk cord around his saya until his fingers bleed.
answers.relationships:
Kaito Nagafusa (Phoenix) — Kaito Nagafusa, of the Phoenix, is the shugenja Yoshiteru has already chosen to let fail—the one whose breathing he does not listen for in the ward, the one he will not die protecting, and she knows it.
Moto Sakuro (Unicorn) — Moto Sakuro of the Unicorn arrived at the Phoenix compound three years ago as part of a trade negotiation, spent a week in the courtyard watching Yoshiteru draw his blade at dusk, and has since written twice asking whether the Phoenix would consider a formal exchange of warriors—which Yoshiteru has not answered, because answering honestly would require admitting that he recognized in her the same fracture between duty and judgment that breaks him.

parent_opinion.description: His mother says he has never learned to let anything fail, and that the silk cord around his saya grows tighter every season because he is still trying to bind something that broke before he was born.
